title: Elders
definition: Elders are qualified spiritual leaders called to shepherd, oversee, teach, and care for the local church under Christ.
summary: Christ appoints elders to shepherd His people according to His Word.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the Chief Shepherd, and elders serve under His authority for the good of the flock.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Elders teaches that Christ does not redeem people into isolation but into a gathered, accountable, worshiping, serving, and mission-shaped people. The Church belongs to Jesus, is formed by the Gospel, and is strengthened by the Word, prayer, ordinances, fellowship, and Spirit-empowered service.

This doctrine helps believers see the Church as more than a place to attend. It is the household of God, the body of Christ, and a visible witness to the grace, holiness, unity, and truth of the Lord.

The specific emphasis here is christ appoints elders to shepherd his people according to his word.. A healthy church life displays Christ's care for His people and His mission to the world.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many people treat church as optional, consumer-driven, or disconnected from discipleship. Elders calls believers back to Christ's design for His people, where worship, truth, love, accountability, service, and mission are held together.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Participate in church life with humility and faithfulness. Let elders move you to serve, forgive, gather, pray, give, submit to Scripture, care for others, and help the body of Christ grow in love and maturity.
